# Jayrun 0.3.4 — follow a run through completion

The dashboard now keeps recently finished runs within reach. Open **Contexts**, search for a run, and select its ID to inspect the same run after it finishes. The active table and its detail panel stay aligned as other runs start and finish. The pager appears above 25 active matches.

**Activity → Execution logs** shows messages retained from `self.execution.log(...)` after finalization. Each message identifies its step, graph iteration, execution and attempt. **Records** holds values written with `self.context.record(...)`.

The graph viewer keeps the camera and selection through finalization, fits larger graphs on small screens, and keeps the selected tab visible. History can find a displayed ID after a dashboard restart when its run was recorded in SQLite. Custom storage backends used for dashboard History should support the `by_finish` and `identity_digest` fields of `HistoryQuery`.

The README opens with installation and a completed graph you can explore. The manual includes corrected runnable examples and redirects for eight former chapters. [Dashboard guide](https://jayrun.readthedocs.io/en/latest/guides/visualization/dashboard.html) · [First graph](https://jayrun.readthedocs.io/en/latest/start/first-graph.html)
